captions: Tab. 11.7 Unit process inventory of the dataset “electronic component, unspecified, at plant (GLO)”
reason: Tab. 11.7 on p.196 is the unit process inventory of 'electronic component, unspecified, at plant (GLO)' — the generic mix of electronic components per kg, which is what 'Electronic components, washing machine, at plant' is derived from; the report contains no washing-machine-specific component dataset. Tab. 11.4 (p.194) gives the composition behind it and Tab. 11.5/11.6 are the passive-only and active-only variants sharing the same pages.
